cosmic-gray.description: A heavy working day: several workspaces of split terminals, agents streaming output, a few local pages, steady layout churn.
cosmic-gray.busy_command: while :; do echo "$RANDOM $RANDOM $RANDOM stress output line $(date +%s)"; sleep {sleep}; done
cosmic-gray.agent_command:
i=0; while :; do i=$((i+1)); printf '\033]0;{name} working %s\007' "$i"; printf '\033[1;36m*\033[0m {name}: reading src/module_%d.rs
' "$i"; printf '  \033[2m-> read %d lines, editing hunk %d\033[0m
' $((i*7%400)) $((i%9)); printf '\033[32m+ let value_%d = compute(%d);\033[0m
\033[31m- let value_%d = old(%d);\033[0m
' "$i" "$i" "$i" "$i"; sleep {sleep}; done

unreasonable.description: Past any real session: many workspaces, every pane split, dozens of agents, many pages, a 10,000-event burst every few seconds and churn as fast as the app takes it.
unreasonable.busy_command: while :; do echo "$RANDOM $RANDOM $RANDOM stress output line $(date +%s)"; sleep {sleep}; done
